_readme: Business facts for schema and NAP (name, address, phone). Single source: every page's JSON-LD is built from this. A fact is published ONLY when verified is true. Flip a fact to true when its Fact Sheet entry is approved in writing, then run python3 elementor/build.py.

name.source: Fact Sheet A: business name (legal name/DBA still to confirm)

legalName.source: Fact Sheet C: legal entity name

description.value: Residential and commercial HVAC service across Greater Houston.

logo.source: Current logo; swap URL when approved logo files arrive (Fact Sheet B-1)

telephone.source: Fact Sheet B-2: public phone (number is from the old site)

email.source: Fact Sheet: public email, if used

address.source: Fact Sheet A/C: operating base. Publish only if Jerry confirms address treatment (staffed, signed, OK to show). Never add market-page addresses.

openingHours.source: Fact Sheet B-3: public hours. Format: ["Mo-Fr 08:00-17:00"]

sameAs.source: Current social links from the old site; confirm they're Catalyst's active profiles (Instagram handle on the old site looked misspelled, left out)

foundingDate.source: Old site says 'early 2024'; Fact Sheet C: year founded

areaServed.source: Fact Sheet A operating familiarity + six market pages (B-8 confirms final list). Areas served, not locations.
